The First Comment feature is out now making it easy to "Add hashtags" and to extend the reach of your posts while keeping your captions focused. 

Given below is a step by step guide to Add First Comment

Step 1

Go to the Publish Icon and click on the composer from the drop-down menu.

Step 2

Click on Social Media Posts.

  • You will be directed to the Composer page as shown below.

Step 3: Where do You Want to post?

Select the Content Category (optional) and Accounts [page(s), and group(s)] where you want to post your content.

Step 4

Enable the toggle button to "Add First Comment".

  • Another Text Area will appear above the "Add First Comment" as shown below.

Note: Your first comment on Facebook Group posts will be posted on behalf of your Facebook page, it will not be posted if you select the Profile under the "Publish As" Column.

Step 5

To add the hashtags in the first comment click on the hash icon in the right corner. A drop-down list will help you add hashtags from the saved list or you can also add new hashtags.

Note: Add first Comment Option is available only for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Youtube.

Step 6

Click on the Post Now button.

  1. For assistance regarding "When to Publish this?" follow https://docs.contentstudio.io/article/359-change-time-and-date-of-a-post
  2. For a step by step guide on "Would, you like to repeat this post?" follow https://docs.contentstudio.io/article/850-how-to-repeat-posts-with-social-composer

Step 7

Your First comment is Published.

Refresh your Facebook page(s) and group(s) and First Comment is live.
